# `band_bursts`

the bursts of a band on the recording's time axis, from the band's amplitude per tile of its time grid level.

Version 2, scope `subject`. Run it with `nxr-neuro run band_bursts --dataset <folder> --subject <id> ...`; `nxr-neuro run band_bursts --help` prints the same options.

Examples:

```
nxr-neuro run select_time_grid --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --recording rest --rule band --band "8-16 Hz"   # the band's time grid, once
nxr-neuro run band_bursts --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --all                                # alpha (8-16 Hz), the whole recording
nxr-neuro run band_bursts --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --band "4-8 Hz" --all                # theta's tile
```

## Inputs

| input | what it is | required |
|---|---|---|
| `recording` | field recording, each true, where {"name": "$recording"} | yes |
| `grid` | selection any, manifold recording.time, where {"name": "{recording} time grid band ${band}"} (the band's time grid (`nxr-neuro run select_time_grid --rule band --band 8-16Hz` first)) | yes |
| `bad` | selection spans, manifold recording.time, where {"name": "{recording}_bad_segments"}, required false | no |

## Parameters

Each is an option `--<name> VALUE` (dashes for underscores; the value is read as YAML) or `--set NAME=VALUE`.

| parameter | option | default | unit | choices | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `recording` | `--recording` | `none` | - |  | the recording's name, or none: every recording of the subject, one run each |
| `band` | `--band` | `8-16 Hz` | Hz |  | the band as a quantity: its time level is resolved from it; alpha at the hertz anchor |
| `shape` | `--shape` | `morlet` | - |  | the temporal band's shape: morlet \| meyer (compact edges: bands that add up) |
| `combine` | `--combine` | `each` | - |  | each: per channel (detect.spindle) \| mean: one trace, the mean over channels |
| `enter_sd` | `--enter-sd` | `1.5` | robust SD |  | robust SDs above the median to enter (labelalpha's hiSD) |
| `exit_sd` | `--exit-sd` | `1.0` | robust SD |  | robust SDs above the median to extend a burst (labelalpha's loSD) |
| `merge_s` | `--merge-s` | `0.1` | s |  | gaps up to this are joined (Rheome's labelalpha, the default); with durations cycles, merge_cycles is used instead |
| `merge_cycles` | `--merge-cycles` | `1.0` | cycles |  | durations cycles: gaps up to this many cycles of the band's centre are joined (the nxr spindle_envelope) |
| `min_s` | `--min-s` | `0.4` | s |  | the bursts kept are at least this long |
| `max_s` | `--max-s` | none | s |  | the bursts kept are at most this long; null: no upper bound |
| `min_cycles` | `--min-cycles` | `3.0` | cycles |  | durations cycles: the bursts kept are at least this many cycles of the band's centre |
| `max_cycles` | `--max-cycles` | none | cycles |  | durations cycles: at most this many cycles; null: no upper bound |
| `durations` | `--durations` | `seconds` | - | seconds, cycles | seconds (merge_s, min_s, max_s) \| cycles (merge_cycles, min_cycles, max_cycles, of the band's centre) |
| `bad_segments` | `--bad-segments` | `exclude` | - |  | exclude \| ignore the recording's bad spans |
| `burst_summaries` | `--burst-summaries` | `["count", "sum", "median", "mean", "sd", "percentile:25", "percentile:75", "percentile:90"]` | - |  | the statistics across the bursts, per measurement |

## The chain of nodes

| phase | node | in | with | out |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| chunks over `recording` | [`signal.envelope`](../nodes.md) | x=recording | band=$band, shape=$shape | amp |
| chunks over `recording` | [`measurement.reduce`](../nodes.md) | x=amp, over=grid, exclude=bad | measures=["amplitude", "envelope_max"], bad_segments=$bad_segments | tiles, tiles_ingredients |
| after | [`measurement.summarize`](../nodes.md) | x=tiles | measure=amplitude, summaries=["median", "mad"], combine=$combine | baseline |
| after | [`select.events.spans`](../nodes.md) | x=tiles, baseline=baseline | rule=detect, measure=amplitude, combine=$combine, enter_sd=$enter_sd, exit_sd=$exit_sd, merge_s=$merge_s, min_s=$min_s, max_s=$max_s, durations=$durations, merge_cycles=$merge_cycles, min_cycles=$min_cycles, max_cycles=$max_cycles | bursts |
| after | [`measurement.reduce_members`](../nodes.md) | x=tiles_ingredients, over=bursts | measures=["amplitude", "envelope_max", "duration", "interval_next"] | burst_values, burst_values_ingredients |
| after | [`measurement.summarize`](../nodes.md) | x=burst_values | summaries=$burst_summaries, combine=$combine | burst_stats |

`before` steps run once, `chunks` steps run on every chunk of the recording, `after` steps run once on what the chunks accumulated.

## Outputs

| output | stored as |
|---|---|
| `tiles` | kind measurement, over grid, of recording |
| `baseline` | kind statistic, of tiles, over grid |
| `bursts` | kind spans, types ["burst"], detected_over grid |
| `burst_values` | kind measurement, over bursts, of recording |
| `burst_stats` | kind statistic, of burst_values, over bursts |

## Notes from the definition

```text
THE BURSTS OF A BAND, labelled on the recording's time axis (spec docs/specs/2026-11-13-time-events.md; the chain of docs/specs/2026-11-17-consolidation.md section 9.1). THE GRAPH:
  recording -- field.form envelope (the band's amplitude) -- reduce {over: the time grid at the band's level} --> amplitude, envelope_max per tile (a measurement over a GRID)
  -- summarize --> the baseline (median and robust SD per channel over the good tiles) -- select.events.spans (Rheome's rule: enter at median + 1.5 SD, extend while >= + 1.0 SD, join gaps, keep by
  duration) --> the bursts (an IRREGULAR selection, detected over the grid; each member described by its centre and extent) -- reduce {over: the bursts} --> each burst's amplitude, peak, duration,
  interval -- summarize --> the statistics across the bursts (a `summary`, never a per-member statistic).
The band is a QUANTITY (Hz): the time grid's level is resolved from it in closed form (the Studio's `fitLevelOf`: the first 2^k samples holding 4 cycles of the band's centre) and recorded with the
snapped tile length; the grid is the line's stored `<recording> time grid band <band>` (`run select_time_grid --rule band`, once per band). The filters of the bursts are quantities in physical units: a duration range, a gap to join.
Stored: the tile measurements, the baseline, the bursts, the bursts' measurements and their statistics.

  nxr-neuro run select_time_grid --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --recording rest --rule band --band "8-16 Hz"   # the band's time grid, once
  nxr-neuro run band_bursts --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --all                                # alpha (8-16 Hz), the whole recording
  nxr-neuro run band_bursts --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --band "4-8 Hz" --all                # theta's tile
```
